text:
marie (pm): Drafting internal announcement for tomorrow's rollout (v2.3.1). Posting proposed copy, change window, and rollback thresholds — please review by 10:30 PT and flag anything that must be called out to Support.

rahul (eng-rel): Thanks — can you confirm the change window? I'd prefer 02:00-03:30 UTC to avoid peak traffic. Also will run canary first.

marie (pm): Change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:30 UTC (canary starts at 02:00). Internal announce copy below — please suggest edits.

marie (pm): ```
Release: v2.3.1 - Serving runtime & routing fixes
When: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:30 UTC (canary -> progressive)
Impact: brief request throttling & schema validation lag for small % of requests during rollout
Key items:
 - Fix: KV cache regression causing tail-latency spikes
 - Improvement: smarter fallback routing for model variants
 - Ops: controlled canary -> progressive rollout with automatic fallback to v2.3.0
Rollback criteria:
 - Error rate increase > 0.5% sustained for 15m
 - 99th p90 latency increase > 40% for 10m
Contacts: @rahul (eng-rel), @ops-oncall, @jordyn (devex)
Runbook: <link to runbook>
```

jordyn (devex): Minor copy tweak: change "brief request throttling" -> "short-duration throttling" and add a bullet calling out dedicated customers will be scheduled for a separate migration window. Also I'll attach the runbook link.

kevin (marketing): Tone looks fine for internal. Suggest adding a short "customer impact" line we can repurpose for CSM if needed. Something like: "Most customers: no action. A tiny percent may see a transient increase in latency; we will rollback if thresholds hit."

ops-oncall: Rollback plan high-level: pin traffic to v2.3.0 via traffic-router, run db rollback not required. Steps: 1) Pause progressive rollout, 2) trigger pin with /pin-version v2.3.0, 3) monitor metrics for 30m, 4) follow post-rollback checklist. Thresholds as in the note. I'll be on-call during the window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created by @rahul for 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Canary command: `/deploy canary v2.3.1 5% 20m` — confirm when ready.

rahul (eng-rel): I'll run `/deploy canary v2.3.1 5% 20m` at 02:00 UTC, then ramp to 25% for 15m if metrics look good. Monitoring plan: 5xx, overall error rate, 99th latency, and cost delta. I'll post a short status update at each ramp.

marie (pm): Thanks — @jordyn can you add the runbook link in the thread and then I can send the internal brief to #general and Support at 11:00 PT? Also confirm CSM snippet from @kevin included.

jordyn (devex): Added runbook: <https://confluence.internal/runbooks/v2-3-1-deploy>. Pinned in release notes doc. LGTM :shipit:

rahul (eng-rel): All set from infra side. Will also add a temporary alert to slack-channel integration if error rate > 0.3% before rollback threshold so we can act faster.

marie (pm): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the internal announcement at 11:00 PT and include the rollout + rollback summary and contact list.
